text: IMD orange alert for Krishnagiri district: very heavy rainfall likely over the next 48 hrs, low-lying industrial areas around Hosur expected to be waterlogged.
Tamil Nadu clinch Ranji Trophy contest against Mumbai by an innings at Chepauk.
Fire at Bengaluru PCB Assembly unit; SMT line gutted, management says operations will resume only after 10 days.
JNPT advisory: container handling suspended at all terminals for 5 days owing to crane operators' agitation. Importers to plan accordingly.
CBIC notification: basic customs duty on imported NdFeB permanent magnets hiked from 7.5% to 20% with immediate effect.
Msg from Coimbatore Alloy Works: our induction furnace transformer has failed, pouring stopped. Kindly expect 4 days delay on castings.
Strike called off: Hosur SIPCOT workers' union withdraws proposed stir after wage settlement with managements.
Karnataka bandh on Wednesday called by farmer groups across the state; lorries and goods vehicles to stay off the roads for the day.
TANGEDCO announces 12-hour power cut in Madurai industrial estate on Saturday for substation upgradation.
Nifty ends flat; auto stocks mixed ahead of monthly sales numbers.
Severe waterlogging in Chennai and adjoining Kancheepuram district after lake surplus release; factories on the Sriperumbudur stretch shut till water drains, likely 3 days.
Lorry owners across Maharashtra begin indefinite strike against diesel price hike; goods movement in Pune and Mumbai badly hit.
IMD: partly cloudy sky with possibility of light drizzle over Coimbatore; no warning for the next 5 days.
Chennai Port Trust: vessel berthing and container evacuation suspended for 3 days due to a terminal operating system outage.
Govt imposes additional anti-dumping duty of 18% on Li-ion cell imports from 1 December.
Pune Municipal Corporation to shut water supply in Kothrud area on Thursday for pipeline work.
Boiler explosion at Manesar Motor Tech; plant sealed for safety audit, shutdown likely for 6 days.
Hosur Harness Co: crimping machine breakdown, harness output halted for 36 hours till spares come from Bangalore.
Bangalore metro Purple Line services to start 30 minutes early during Dasara festival week.
NH-44 blocked near Krishnagiri after tanker overturns; Hosur-bound trucks stranded, clearance expected only by tomorrow evening.
